contact.address: Uttam Palace, Sapru Marg, Hazratganj, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – 226001

projects.title: Uttam Palace
projects.summary: A landmark commercial address on Sapru Marg — a confident street wall that holds Hazratganj's heritage axis.
projects.description: Uttam Palace is a flagship commercial development conceived as a contemporary counterpart to the colonial architecture of Hazratganj. A deep stone plinth grounds the building to the avenue while a recessed glass volume above lets the upper floors recede behind a layered façade. Internally, the building is organised around a sky-lit atrium that brings daylight to every floor.

projects.title: Penguin Tower
projects.summary: A high-rise office tower that reads as a single, slim vertical gesture against the city skyline.
projects.description: Penguin Tower is a 14-storey commercial high-rise designed for boutique offices and a curated retail base. Vertical aluminium fins articulate the façade and modulate the strong westerly sun, while a double-height sky-lobby on the seventh floor offers tenants a shared garden space cantilevered out over the street.

projects.title: SR Hospital
projects.summary: A multi-specialty hospital where the architecture is calibrated for calm — daylight, soft volumes, and a clear path of care.
projects.description: SR Hospital was designed around a single principle: that a healing building must, above all, be quiet. Wards are organised around landscaped light-wells; circulation is split between staff and visitor flows; and the public faces of the building use a soft, warm palette of cream stone and timber to soften the institutional scale.

projects.title: Modern Villa — Gomti Nagar
projects.summary: A modern residence in Gomti Nagar — three wings folded around a private central court.
projects.description: Conceived as a sequence of thresholds, the villa stretches around a generous central court anchored by an existing mango tree. Concrete fins articulate the western face, slowing the afternoon light into soft horizontal bands; the eastern wing opens fully to the morning sun via a deep, shaded verandah.

projects.title: Green Meadows Township
projects.summary: An integrated township master-plan that puts the green network — not the road network — at the centre of community life.
projects.description: Green Meadows is a 42-acre township master-plan in which the central spine is not a road but a continuous landscape — a pedestrian green that links every cluster, school and community building. The vehicular network is pushed to the perimeter, allowing the inner blocks to be unhurried, walkable, and densely planted.

projects.title: Heritage Bungalow — Mall Avenue
projects.summary: A careful adaptive reuse of a colonial-era bungalow, reawakened as a modern family home.
projects.description: The original 1930s bungalow was retained in its entirety; new programme is added as a discreet glass-and-steel pavilion to the rear, connected to the old house by a glazed link. The work is a study in restraint — every new element is set back, set apart, or set below the original.

projects.title: Riverside Resort
projects.summary: A boutique resort along the Gomti — an architecture of pitched roofs, deep verandahs, and a long, slow approach to the water.
projects.description: The resort is conceived as a small village of low pitched-roof pavilions threaded along the river edge. Locally fired brick, timber, and lime-washed walls give the architecture a quiet, regional character; the longest move is the approach itself — a 200-metre walk under a canopy of mature trees that ends at the water.

projects.title: The Wardrobe Showroom
projects.summary: A flagship retail interior — inked walls, deep oak, and a sequence of carefully composed display rooms.
projects.description: The showroom is conceived as a series of "rooms within a room" — each defined by a different tonal pairing of plaster and timber. Custom millwork wraps the spine of the space, and the lighting is calibrated almost entirely for fabric: soft, warm, and shadow-free. The dressing rooms occupy the most private corner, lined in a deep ink-blue cloth.

projects.title: Sapru Marg Residence
projects.summary: A family apartment on Sapru Marg — soft curves, plaster the colour of dawn, and a single long oak spine.
projects.description: Every interior wall is a soft curve and the rooms blur into one another. The palette is drawn from raw materials — limewashed plaster, cane, brushed brass — and held together by a single warm undertone. A continuous oak spine runs the full length of the apartment, holding books, art and storage in one quiet gesture.

projects.title: Cantt Boutique Hotel
projects.summary: A 22-room boutique hotel — a quiet, tonal palette and rooms that feel more like libraries than hotels.
projects.description: A 22-key boutique hotel with a careful, library-like character. The lobby is treated as a long reading room; the rooms are organised as small studies with a writing desk at every window. Nothing is loud, nothing is corporate — and every detail, down to the door pulls, is custom.

projects.title: Aliganj Family Home
projects.summary: An interior of restraint, designed for a young family. The only ornament is daylight.
projects.description: A near-monochromatic interior — white plaster, pale stone, bleached ash — designed as a quiet stage for a young family's daily life. Light is the principal material; built-in millwork hides the practical clutter of family living without ever drawing attention to itself.

projects.title: Indira Nagar Office
projects.summary: A professional services office, organised around a single long table and one good library.
projects.description: An office for a small professional firm. The whole floor is treated as one continuous loft, anchored by a 24-foot communal worktable; private rooms are tucked behind a long, full-height oak library that doubles as the firm's archive.
